tests: an agent turn delivers a status record that validates, and the current document is the read path

consumesExternalOutput.program: tiphys status emit, tiphys status show and tiphys validate, run as real subprocesses
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Every status assertion reads what the kernel's own commands wrote or printed. The status paths are imported from src/status.ts rather than spelled in the test, so the M4-D-13 move cannot leave this witness asserting about a file nothing writes.
